scope: Proposition 3.1 (Scalar change of channel) of the manuscript “Cylinder amplitudes and logarithmic bridge-length windows on the honeycomb lattice” (preprints/Cylinder-amplitudes-and-logarithmic-bridge-length-windows-on-the-honeycomb-lattice-September-26-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 237 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 de92d884cd5298c4), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 20. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix L > 0, ordered angular layers with the prescribed common-layer boundary values, and a finite ordered list of fields with charges βi as above. Use the indicated lifts of O and Mb and the cocycle convention of the fields Vβi . For U = Mb, impose the neutrality condition P i hβi = 0; without it the scalar trace contribution is zero. Let Si be the displayed self multiplier, Cij the exponential of the displayed short-range cross logarithm for xi < xj, and Kf the displayed kinetic factor. The angular trace contribution for this list is TU (β, u) = ZU aU X f∈FU eπiΦ Kf Y i Si Y xi<xj Cij, aMb = s L 2πHb , aO = 1. (3.1) Here FMb = −ϕ/(2π)+Z. For O the sum consists of one term, Kf = 1, and all fixed-axis terms in Φ are omitted. The identity first holds with the separated representatives and prescribed boundary values above; Section 3.4 supplies the convergence and continuation required for the full root expansion.
